cloud-palace-minimax-h3 1.0.0

- Initial release of the dual-channel "云上仙宫" prompt generator for image and MiniMax H3 video.
- Supports generation of epic Oriental fantasy prompts for both static images (高标准六维结构) and movie-quality MiniMax H3 video (T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA/Ref2VA).
- Strict channel selection and output format; always outputs pure prompts only, with no explanations or extra text.
- Provides comprehensive theme libraries, detailed structure templates, and fixed style/technique requirements for both channels.
- Strictly follows all MiniMax H3 official prompt conventions for video generation.
